description: This file defines a PHP class 'Chart_pipeline_by_lead_source' responsible for generating a pipeline chart based on lead sources in a CRM system. It includes methods to draw the chart, generate XML data for the chart, and construct SQL queries to fetch opportunity data filtered by lead source and user preferences.

classes.name: Chart_pipeline_by_lead_source
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering a lead source pipeline chart, including data retrieval, XML chart data creation, and chart display.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles rendering the chart interface, processing user preferences, and displaying the generated chart.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates XML data for the pie chart based on lead source data and opportunity totals.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Creates the SQL query to fetch opportunity data filtered by lead sources and user preferences.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the SQL GROUP BY clause for lead source.
